title: Western Illinois women's basketball travels to face Morehead State Eagles
text:
Western Illinois University Leathernecks Women's Basketball | Western Illinois University Leathernecks
Western Illinois University Leathernecks Women's Basketball | Western Illinois University Leathernecks
The Western Illinois University Leathernecks Women's Basketball team will travel to Morehead, Kentucky, to face the Morehead State Eagles on Thursday, January 22, 2026. The game is scheduled for a 4 p.m. CT tip-off at Johnson Arena.
Western Illinois enters the matchup with a record of 15-2 overall and 7-1 in Ohio Valley Conference (OVC) play. This season marks the team's third year competing in the OVC. The Leathernecks are based in Macomb, Illinois, and play their home games on campus as part of the university's intercollegiate athletics program. The team uses the Leathernecks nickname to honor the U.S. Marine Corps and is represented by Rocky the Leatherneck as its mascot, according to their official website.
In their last outing, Western Illinois secured a 75–59 road win over Little Rock in conference action. Senior Mia Nicastro led all scorers with 28 points and collected 14 rebounds for a double-double performance. She shot 9-of-14 from the field and was perfect at the free-throw line, making all nine attempts. Addi Brownfield contributed 16 points with three three-pointers, while Mallory Shetley and Allie Meadows added 13 and 12 points respectively.
Morehead State approaches this contest with a record of approximately .500 for the season and has demonstrated strong three-point shooting throughout their campaign. The Eagles lead the OVC in three-point attempts per game and rank near the top of the league in made shots from beyond the arc. Players such as Violet McNece and Anja Ekstrom are among their primary long-range shooters, while forward Kate Dike leads in scoring and rebounding.
The two teams last met on February 15, 2025, when Western Illinois won by a score of 78-73.
Following this game against Morehead State, Western Illinois will continue its road trip by facing Southern Indiana at 1 p.m.
For more information about Western Illinois University Leathernecks Women's Basketball or to follow updates on upcoming games, visit GoLeathernecks.com or follow them on social media platforms including X (formerly Twitter), Instagram, and Facebook.
